## SECURITY NOTICE

**⚠️ IMPORTANT: For security vulnerabilities, please email security@frontal.dev instead of using this template.**

This template is for non-critical security-related issues only. For critical security vulnerabilities, follow our [Security Policy](../../SECURITY.md).
